full_judgment: The respondent filed Pre-emption Case No. 82 of 1980 in the then Second Court of Munsif (now Assistant Judge), Sadar, Sylhet under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 for pre-emption. The case of the pre-emptor, in short, is that the case holding originally belonged to Hason Miah, the predecessor-in-interest of the pre-emptors and some of the respondents of the pre-emption case and the khatian was accordingly prepared and finally published. On the death of Hason Miah, the preemptor's predecessor, Barkatullah and others became owners and subsequently, on the death of Barkatullah, the pre-emptor and others became co-sharers in the case holding. Respondent Nos. 2- 7 of the original miscellaneous case transferred the case land behind the back of the pre-emptor to the preemptee-appellant who is a stranger to the case holding.
